description:
FILED s516b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-12): after #3240 (Type::Tiny.pm loads) and #3280 (SUPER::isa(@_) flattens), `use Types::Standard -all` stops at the next blocker.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs the s516b tree):

    require B;
    print B::perlstring("a\"b\$c\n\x{263a}"), "\n";

perl: "a\"b\$c\n\x{263a}" (a double-quoted perl literal).  PCL: dies `Can't locate B.pm in @INC (the module is XS and has no PCL build -- see tools/pcl-xs-install)`.

REACH: Type-Tiny-2.010001 lib/Type/Tiny.pm uses B at 484, 610, 1012-1051, 1128, 1589 (`B::svref_2object(...)->XSUB`), 1624, 1633, and B::Deparse at 943; probe: scratch/s516b/pr/tt2.pl in the s516b worktree (`require Type::Tiny; require Types::Standard; Types::Standard->import('-all')` with Type-Tiny + Exporter-Tiny lib dirs on @INC).  Also the most common B use on CPAN generally (perlstring / cstring for code generation, svref_2object for sub names and flags).

FIX LAYER (rule 9a): a `lib/B.pm` shim -- B is core, its pure-perl-expressible parts are perlstring / cstring (string escapers) and a narrow svref_2object (->GV->NAME, ->STASH->NAME, ->XSUB, ->FLAGS for the number-vs-string idiom) answered from runtime facts.  Size it first: list which B:: entry points the board + Type-Tiny + Moo/Sub-Quote reach (grep -a the four populations), shim those, and let the rest die naming the entry point (rule 12).  Not attempted in s516b (a design item, not a filler).
=== DONE (s518e, member 1) ===
MEASURED (the B entry points the populations call): Type::Tiny perlstring (~70 sites) + svref_2object(...)->XSUB (_has_xsub) + B::Deparse (validate_explain); Sub::Quote `defined &B::perlstring`; Class::Method::Modifiers ->GV->STASH->NAME (fresh); Sub::Identify / Test2::Util::Sub ->GV->NAME / ->FILE / ->START; CPAN::Meta::YAML `use B` + ->FLAGS & SVf_POK (the dzil t/00-report-prereqs.t that the six board *FILE* rows cite); JSON::PP / YAML::PP ->FLAGS (JSON::PP only under PERL_JSON_PP_USE_B).
SHIPPED: lib/B.pm (must-win shim): perlstring / cstring written from B.xs's rules, byte-identical to perl over all 256 byte values + wide strings (scratch probe and Pl/t/b-shim-01.t); class, safename, the SVf_*/CVf_* constants, @specialsv_name; svref_2object -> B::CV (GV NAME/SAFENAME/STASH, STASH, XSUB=0, START/ROOT isa B::NULL for an undefined sub, object_2svref), scalar refs -> B::IV/NV/PV/PVNV/PVMG/NULL by representation with FLAGS (IOK/NOK/POK/ROK), IV/NV/PV/RV; GLOB/ARRAY/HASH refs -> B::GV/AV/HV objects.  Every other function / constant / method dies naming itself (AUTOLOADs; op accessors defined so ->can probes die loudly).  lib/B/Deparse.pm dies at require (perl-shaped, trappable).
RUNTIME (generic primitives only, no B:: name in cl/): `builtin::sub_name` (the 'Pkg::name' a sub was DEFINED under, recorded by p-sub at install in the weak %pcl-sub-names -- an alias does not change it; ir-spec normative paragraph) and `builtin::created_as_integer` (IOK vs NOK).  No emission change, no generation bump.
ACCEPTANCE: `use lib <Type-Tiny/lib>, <Exporter-Tiny/lib>; require Type::Tiny; require Types::Standard; Types::Standard->import('-all')` LOADS (and Int->check works); the six board 00-report-prereqs.t *FILE* rows: CMM's measured 1/0 alone (the board leg confirms the rest).  Guard Pl/t/b-shim-01.t 289 rows (3.6 s), all fail on a main extraction.
FILED: #3390 (`my $v = ${ $h{k} }` with a ref-to-ref element loses the reference -- silent wrong; the shim works around it), #3391 (#2764 residue: a module that dies at load prints the SBCL herald on every run).
NOT DONE (documented in not-supported.md "B"): the package of an ANONYMOUS sub (its STASH dies), XSUB is 0 for every sub, FILE/CvFLAGS/PADLIST/MAGIC/REFCNT die, a dualvar's FLAGS die.
subject: core `B` has no PCL shim: `require B; B::perlstring($s)` dies "Can't locate B.pm (the module is XS and has no PCL build)" -- the third Type::Tiny load blocker (Types::Standard reaches Type/Tiny.pm's `require B` while loading; 14 B:: call sites in Type/Tiny.pm, mostly perlstring)
